name: Single-Arm Push-Up
steps: Take a high plank with feet wide, one hand beneath your chest and the other behind your back.
Brace your abs, obliques, and glutes tightly to keep your hips and shoulders as square to the floor as possible.
Bend your working elbow close to your ribs to lower your chest slowly toward the floor.
Press powerfully through your palm to extend your arm back to lockout, and switch arms after completing one side.
tips: Widen your stance to reduce torso rotation, or narrow it as your core strength improves.
Keep your working elbow angled close to your side rather than flaring directly out.
